children: Huawei Technologies is said to have notified some clients that it’s significantly hiking the prices of its most advanced AI accelerators, reflecting how demand is rapidly outstripping supply during the data center boom.
The suggested price for Huawei’s Ascend 950DT jumped roughly 60% to 250,000 yuan ($37,300) apiece over the past three months, according to Bloomberg.
That price was set in line with Nvidia's

B200, the report said. Both Nvidia and Huawei sell their artificial intelligence processors in batches of eight or more, and their pricing varies with the size of the order and how much each customer buys of auxiliary equipment like networking.

But the company is grappling with production hiccups. Huawei’s sales representatives have told customers that the supply of high-bandwidth memory is particularly limited and pushing up costs, the report said, citing sources. The use of HBM in AI systems is at the root of the global memory shortage of the past year, and Huawei, earlier this week, also launched a new flagship smartphone with otherwise premium specs but limited memory.
earlier reported the Ascend 950DT price jump and said Beijing-based Cambricon Technologies Corp. is also increasing prices by as much as 30%.

title: Huawei raises advanced AI chip prices 60% as demand outpaces supply: report
